Center the remaining supports between the jaws, close, and make a small vertical retention-check lift.

Release the seated middle supports, then lift and withdraw without brushing the lower board.

Level the retained board, raise it clear of the middle supports, then carry it toward the tower.

Fine-center the small wooden board, close the right gripper, and lift slightly to verify retention.

Lift the green cap with the left gripper and straighten its yaw. Withdraw the open right gripper from the seated top board.
